problem_type: Fork integration source ownership is missing from the shared registry
symptom: The explicit fork/main added-source gate reports 180 files in the isolated branch and 182 in the main working tree without a self-written owner.
direct_cause: Capability additions and existing-library adapters were introduced without extending the concrete domain inventory or mechanism registrations.
class_root: A source addition needs a verifiable shared ownership decision: domain data/glue, an existing-library adapter, or an explicitly bounded replacement/review plan.
affected_population: New Electron integration and canvas sources relative to the user fork/main target
Renderer display helpers, coordinator locale and PNG fixture additions
entry_points: check-prior-art.mjs explicit PRIOR_ART_BASE_REF=fork/main and real PR-body reference

external_sources.purpose: A real generic structural-sharing alternative, not an installed dependency claim
Distinguish existing display translation calls from the still-handwritten desktop interpolator

invariants: Use the user fork/main reference, not the official default branch
Preserve enforceFrom, genericZones and the 161 existing domain roots
No production source, dependency, baseline, checker, API, prompt, stored data or model surface changes
Every inspected source is tied to a source locator, SHA256 and bounded owner
A to-replace registration is not evidence that its replacement has already shipped

door_reduction.why_not: The added-source gate checks registry ownership; the separate PR gate checks the human prior-art reference. They enforce different obligations and must remain independent. Registry data is edited offline; this change introduces no runtime writer.

generality_proof: Concrete capability roots and exact adapter paths cover every inspected entry, including generic-zone hooks and helpers. Independent tests reject widened policy, silently domain-classified generic mechanisms, missing source evidence, and a registry-changing PR without a qualifying plan reference.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: One machine-readable ownership and replacement-policy inventory consumed by the unchanged existing gates

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Display-only lookup is assigned to the existing-i18next adapter family, with no persistence or prompt mutation
The handwritten ZIP decoder remains outside domain roots and is explicitly to-replace with the already installed fflate alternative and security parity criteria
Generic-zone custom listeners/notify state is assigned an explicit existing-Zustand replacement plan instead of a model-domain exemption

recurrence.reason: Any later capability, UI helper or integration fixture can add a similarly unowned generic mechanism.
same_class_scan: Actual added source under src/electron relative to fork/main, including main working-tree additions
179 inventory entries plus the TSX helper, main-only locale/PNG fixture and the explicitly requested Blender vocabulary contract
Source bodies and AST-assisted import/declaration/call review, with focused full reads of generic mechanisms
Installed fflate, React, Zustand, i18next, React Flow, R3F, Tiptap and Node/DOM API contracts

prevention.invariant: New source must match an honest capability root or an exact, sourced mechanism registration.
prevention.failure_mode: The unchanged gate rejects unknown paths, missing plans, stale paths and invalid metadata; prior-art rejects an unreferenced registry change.
prevention.strategy: Fill the existing shared inventory with audited ownership and explicit replacement obligations, retaining generic exclusion rules and all gate thresholds.

legacy_paths.rationale: No runtime implementation, export, caller or compatibility path is changed or removed.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This is registry metadata repair only. Existing runtime dependencies are not installed, upgraded or swapped; mechanism-specific exit criteria are recorded in the registry and research report.

migration: No stored project or prompt data migration. Coordinator cherry-picks the metadata after its already completed A/helper/locale/fixture source batches.
residual_risks: The isolated branch lacks four actual main integration sources; its real CLI also still sees an old textModelCapabilities implementation already replaced by pure re-export in main. These failures are reported, not bypassed by registering the obsolete model inference copy.
Injected local PR text proves the gate input, not that the remote PR body or CI was updated
Replacement and review items remain open engineering work; no spike, media generation, provider call or App acceptance is claimed
